# Page-text snapshots

Short excerpts of real pages, fetched 2026-11-16. Each file in `snapshots.json` records the URL, the visible sentences that could look like a lure, and the text of the copy buttons on that page.

Nothing here is a script, an image, or a full article. The excerpts exist so a local detector can be checked for false alarms. That is a small quotation for a security test, not a republication of the page. Commands are the functional install lines the pages show.

The reCAPTCHA disclosure line ("This site is protected by reCAPTCHA …") is the badge string the 2026-11-16 review measured. The demo page fetched the same day shows the checkbox label, not that full sentence, and the snapshot says so.
